coverage.summary: 26 SKULLPANDA blind-box series with release years and complete rosters (301 figures), verified from official Pop Mart pages (live US product pages, or Wayback copies of popmart.com/us and global.popmart.com for retired series) and, where noted per series, reputable secondary listings. Complete applies to each listed roster, not to the brand.
gaps: Other Pop Mart SKULLPANDA products and series are outside this supplement.
Media and prices are intentionally not copied from the storefront.
Archived official pages are cited by their web.archive.org URLs and tiered official.
Candy Monster Town names come from one fan site (skullpandaworld.com); Everyday Wonderland and Laid Back Tomorrow names are secondary.
Laid Back Tomorrow's secret is 'Coffee Express' in three sources and 'Coffee Knight' in two; Coffee Express is used.
POP BEAN Petals in Four Acts (2026) is known but its roster was not retrievable.
Multi-character Pop Mart series with one SKULLPANDA figure, merchandise blind boxes (charms, badges, magnets), single plush, MEGA, and one-off figures are not series records here.
